title: Visit Sky If Shes There

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: See something you like or just staring for fun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See something you like or just staring for fun?

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: You couldn't handle this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You couldn't handle this.

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Yeah, thought I'd come check on you. My new fav-or-ite consumer of concise hallucinatory experiences.

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Got an itch? That was quick. What'd yah see at the end? No, wait, let me guess: fire? Wild fires spread from a chemical spill in the Wastes and makes it way toward the city?

nodes.text: Yeah, when Sky gets back and you fuck off I'll be sure to do that. Feel free to get a head start.

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Ohhhh, the pretty one likes the complicated one. Call me shicked I didn't see that one coming. You should be a little more original. It might help.

nodes.text: Ehhh. I've heard better.

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: You are relentless. Anyone ever tell you that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are relentless. Anyone ever tell you that?

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Figures. Tehani had something of mine and I'm just here to grab it back. Sky went to go get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Figures. Tehani had something of mine and I'm just here to grab it back. Sky went to go get it.

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Listen, you smell great and all, but I really don't need or, if we're being honest, want to know that kinda stuff about you. So maybe, I don't know, find something else to do?

nodes.text: Listen, I know you think you're like, part of this whole thing since you've been around all of five seconds, but you're not. So maybe, I don't know, find something else to do?
